data: Microsoft's net income rose from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022 (year ended June 30, 2022) to $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024 (year ended June 30, 2024), an increase of about $15.4 billion, or roughly 21.2%. The growth reflected strong results in Azure and other cloud services, along with the contribution from the Activision Blizzard acquisition, which closed in October 2023. These figures are from memory of Microsoft's annual reports, so confirm them against the 10-K filings if you need exact numbers.
